thread:
Amelia: Quick sync — proposing a lightweight TLV routing rule for SI-sourced leads from cloud marketplaces. TL;DR: assign by ARR band -> vertical -> SI coverage. Ownership window 14d then falls back to AE. Thoughts?
Omar: +1 on ARR band but we should make the fallback immediate if SI doesn't accept within 48h. Sales can't wait on slow handbacks. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Sanjay: Agree on ARR band. Also add a 'technical fit' QA step for >$250k ARR leads — SEs should triage before full handoff.
Marie: Ops note: we need machine-readable mapping to implement this (account tags + si_owner_id). Suggested fields: `si_owner_id`, `arr_band`, `vertical`, `marketplace_ref`. Will add to schema doc.
Amelia: good call. Proposed arr_band buckets: <$50k, $50-250k, >$250k. 14d ownership for all, but auto-escalate to AE after 48h if SI doesn't ack for >$250k.
Noah: For field SIs, can we preference local SI if both are mapped? e.g., same-country > same-region > global. Reduces timezone churn.
Omar: yep local preference makes sense. Also need a rule for co-sell crediting: if SI introduces and closes, they get primary; if AE takes over and closes within 90d, split 60/40 to SI unless legal asks otherwise.
Marie: adding that to the ops checklist. We'll need a periodic sweep job to close stale claims: `cron: daily` that marks claims stale after 14d + notify SI/AE.
PartnersBot: Reminder: link to draft playbook -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/partners/pages/TLV-routing-draft (comment deadline Fri EOD).
Sanjay: tiny nit — for marketplace-referrals, include a source tag (aws/azure/gcp) so we can route to marketplace-enabled SIs only.
Amelia: noted. I'll update the draft with source tags and local-preference logic. Can someone volunteer to own the tech implementation tickets?
Marie: I'll own the mapping schema + data pipeline tickets.
Omar: I'll take the routing policy and co-sell credit rules.
Noah: I'll do a short doc for field SIs on acceptance SLAs.
Amelia: Awesome — thanks team. Posting updated draft by tomorrow AM. :rocket:
PartnersBot: Reaction summary: :thumbsup: 4, :eyes: 2, :rocket: 1
